coral.line: In a room filled with coral
stanza: And the pieces will lay there a while

In a room filled with coral
Sails at the windows, forests of masts
Put your hand over the side of the boat
Put your hand over the side of the boat
And what do you feel?
Between coral
Silent eel
Silver swordfish
I can't really feel or dream down here
So 97th and Laurel
It's all I've ever known
I'm nineteen years old
Just yesterday
And what I have seen
All I've discovered
Is there's nothing for a boy of color

oral.line: Call me thirsty, call me oral
stanza: Keep your hemp and your mushrooms
Your smack and Nembutal
Me, I'm into fruit and grains
Gimme a1cohol
Call me thirsty, call me oral

But when I'm sober, call me Loudon
Do not call me Mike

quarrel.line: But to see both sides of a quarrel
stanza: My father he rides with your sheriffs
And I know he would never mean harm
But to see both sides of a quarrel
Is to judge without hate or alarm
